# Status of the literature claims {#sec-sources}

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
**Status:** stable · **Updated:** 2026-11-21
:::

Each citation in the book is marked by how it was checked. *Full text* means the primary
source was read, and only these citations carry equation or section numbers. *Secondary*
means the claim rests on abstracts or citing works and should be confirmed against the
source. No mathematical statement in the book depends on a citation; each is proved in the
text. This table is updated as sources are read in full (thread T10 of the
[roadmap](../ROADMAP.md)).

| Source | Access | What is used |
|:--|:--|:--|
| @jaynes1957information | full text | Eqs. (2-4) and (2-10); Sec. 3 (Boltzmann distribution); footnote 6 (discrete case only) |
| @kessy2018optimal | full text | Eq. (4), rotational freedom; Eq. (8), ZCA; Eqs. (13) and (14), optimality |
| @diggavi2001worst | full text | Lemma II.2 (Ihara): Gaussian noise is worst at fixed covariance |
| @vanderschaft2014port | full text | Eq. (4.10), input-state-output port-Hamiltonian form |
| @buithanh2013computational | full text | Sec. 3.3, mass-weighted inner product |
| @cotter2013mcmc | full text | robustness under mesh refinement (abstract and Sec. 1) |
| @kubo1966fluctuation | secondary | the FDT links noise intensity to dissipation; equipartition |
| @moore1981principal | secondary | Gramians, coordinate dependence, balancing |
| @li2007connection | secondary | the EfI and MKE connection, via iteration and re-orthonormalization |
| @lee2020geometric | secondary | affine-invariant metric on inertial parameters (parameter space, not state space) |
| @zahedi2013quantifying | secondary | discrete $\mathrm{MC}_W=I(W';W\mid A)$ on empirical distributions |
| @patterson2026quantifying | own work | the leg models, settings and quadruped experiments that the book starts from |
| @wensing2017proprioceptive | secondary | model parameters, as reproduced in @patterson2026quantifying [Sec. III] |
| @cover2006elements | secondary | Ch. 12, maximum entropy; colored-noise channels |
| @kammer1991sensor; @papadimitriou2004optimal | secondary | EfI as D-optimal design; entropy-based sensor placement |
| @willems1972dissipative; @stuart2010inverse | secondary | storage functions; the function-space viewpoint |
| @dupont1973l2; @baker1976error; @geveci1984convergence | secondary | semi-discrete finite-element convergence (an assumption of @thm-mesh) |
| @landauer1961irreversibility; @bennett1982thermodynamics | secondary | reversibility of conservative dynamics; dissipation as erasure |
| @berut2012experimental; @esposito2011second | secondary | the four-stage erasure protocol and its $1/\tau$ excess work; the second law for nonequilibrium free energy and Landauer's bound with errors |
| @callen1951irreversibility | secondary | quantum FDT, $\frac{\hbar\omega}{2}\coth\frac{\hbar\omega}{2k_BT}$ |
| @nyquist1928thermal | secondary | thermal noise set by dissipation |
